caseName: Automobile Drivers & Demonstrators Union Local No. 882 v. Department of Retirement Systems
caseNameFull: Automobile Drivers & Demonstrators Union Local No. 882 v. Department of Retirement Systems of Washington

opinions.text: Appeal from Sup. Ct. Wash, dismissed for want of jurisdiction. Treating the papers whereon the appeal was taken as a petition for writ of certiorari, certiorari denied.
